about.name: Dayan Candamil
about.intro: Dayan Candamil sits at the intersection of capital and culture. As Associate Partner at BlackOak Real Estate, she leads international markets and structures cross-border investment flows between Latin America, the United States, the GCC, Morocco and West Africa — originating complex transactions across prime land, luxury residential and branded developments.
about.body1: Born in Colombia, Dayan trained in law in São Paulo, art history in San Francisco and luxury brand management at the London College of Fashion. Her career runs through Key Biscayne, Panama City, Miami, Marrakech and Dubai — and she routinely coordinates with international counsel, family offices and developer principals on behalf of clients who do not live in the region full-time.
about.h2: A trusted bridge between Latin America and the Gulf.
about.body2: Over recent years she has played a pivotal role in introducing prominent Latin American families and investors to the UAE — supporting relocation, investment and long-term engagement of private capital in the Middle East. Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese, she advises developers on market entry, investor positioning, pricing frameworks and distribution across Latin American and African markets.
about.body3: Sourcing prime and off-market inventory, due diligence, structuring, developer negotiations, relocation — the same point of contact walks each step. No handoffs, no junior account managers.

atelier.heading: House of Candamil
atelier.tagline: Couture-quality accessories, fine jewellery and ready-to-wear.
atelier.intro: What began as a child making jewellery in a Colombian home became a label with a following from Gulf royalty to European and American celebrities. Founded in Dubai in 2020, House of Candamil brings together one-of-a-kind bags, accessories and fine jewellery with a curated edit of home, clothing and lifestyle pieces.
atelier.body1: The house works directly with artisans — from Uzbek embroiderers to Moroccan makers — and has spoken on redesigning fashion to make it more sustainable at the Hult Prize on-campus programme in Morocco. Kuwait's Alanba newspaper profiled the house for its role in preserving heritage crafts.
atelier.body2: Marrakech Fashion Week · Dubai Fashion Week · Globe Soccer Awards, Atlantis The Palm · Mandarin Oriental Dubai 10-year celebration · ELLE Arabia · Harper's Bazaar.
